Baseline

Connected Xbox Series Controller to PicoSwitch2 and plugged into real Switch 2

In pro controller 2 mode -> Worked normally, no weird rumble 
In GC mode -> Immediately started rumbling and wouldn't stop until controller was unplugged

Connected Xbox Series Controller to PicoSwitch2 and plugged into PC

In pro controller 2 mode -> Worked normally, no weird rumble 
In GC mode (Tested with a switch 1 emulator as a GC Controller) -> Rumble doesn't continue indefinitely, but def seems set to max vibration and lasts a bit longer than it would on real hardware
